sections.title: Results & Impact
sections.executive_summary: Nexter showcases CSS Grid mastery for sophisticated real estate layouts, achieving 0.8s page load with only 18KB of CSS. The responsive design requires just 2 breakpoints compared to 5+ with traditional approaches, eliminating layout shifts entirely.

sections.title: CSS Grid Success
highlights: 0.8s page load time with optimized CSS Grid layout
Zero layout shifts with intrinsic sizing

sections.title: Technical Excellence
sections.summary: Nexter proves that CSS Grid eliminates layout hacks and excessive media queries. Named grid lines and minmax() functions create layouts that adapt naturally to any viewport, while the 7-1 SCSS architecture ensures maintainable, scalable stylesheets.
